title: BeSync Phygit
tagline: A BeSync Phygit identifies an asset according to owner, location, time, and spatial dimensions, using Web3.Storage, Filecoin, Tableland, and Polygon
description:
A BeSync phygit is a unit of information identified by owner, measurable dimensions of location, time, and size, and stored on a blockchain.

These coordinates place information relative to their environment, physical, digital, or hybrid. The network functions as a pipeline of information, agnostic of content. Hardware and software can scale up or down, from QR to AR, or from binary to volumetric video.

Participation in a shared, geotemporal data layer gives emerging Web3 applications access to geotemporal and cyberphysical capabilities as well as access to new users and assets.

Web3 systems powered by blockchain with access to shared assets and users can create more powerful, connected, decentralized, cyberphysical systems around Big Tech gatekeepers.

Finally, people and organizations bring their assets and interactions naturally, 
creating a metaverse based on human wants and needs.
how_its_made:
Asset are stored in Filecoin via Web3.Storage and geotemporal data is stored in Tableland/Polygon. 

What BeSync Does, Part 1: “Phygitize” Asset
Accepts a .jpg file with Exif data
Extracts the location and time
Stores the file in Web3.Storage
Creates a record in Tableland

What BeSync Does, Part 2: Explore Phygits
Queries by location and time 
Returns CIDs from Tableland based on parameters
Returns corresponding files from Web3.Storage
Presents assets within their geotemporal coordinates
